# The first own calendar of an account that still sees the virtual
# "privat" makes "privat" real as well (empty, default name and color): an
# iPhone that synced "privat" keeps it, and a PUT it made offline to
# "privat" still lands there.
> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><A:displayname/><C:getctag/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< responses 2
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag 0-0

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 0
< sync-token-is https://ns.titanos.invalid/sync/0/0

> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <B:mkcalendar xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><A:set xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:prop><A:displayname>Arbeit</A:displayname></A:prop></A:set></B:mkcalendar>
< status 201

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/" xmlns:I="http://apple.com/ns/ical/"><A:prop><A:displayname/><C:getctag/><I:calendar-color/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< responses 3
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ d:displayname Privat
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ ical:calendar-color #7c3aed
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/ d:displayname Arbeit

# The offline PUT of the iPhone into "privat".
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: dentist.ics
< status 201
< header ETag {etag:dentist.ics}

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body dentist.ics

# "privat" is real now, with a new epoch: the token of the virtual one is
# 403 valid-sync-token, the iPhone syncs it once in full and keeps it.
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>https://ns.titanos.invalid/sync/0/0</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 403
< error d:valid-sync-token

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 1
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics d:getetag {etag:dentist.ics}

# Deleting "arbeit" leaves "privat"; "privat" is the last one then.
> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/
> Auth: alex
< status 204

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
< status 403
